display.purpose: Hero headings and section titles. Tight tracking at large sizes.

headline.purpose: Sub-section headers, component names in gallery.

body.purpose: Prose, documentation copy. 70ch max line length.

label.purpose: Navigation items, badges, metadata, keyboard shortcuts.

mono.purpose: Code blocks, install commands, API references.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Structural separation for card containers. Barely perceptible at rest.

shadows.name: raised-button
shadows.purpose: Color-matched to button background. Only on RaisedButton. Never generic buttons.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and entrances.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: button press, hover color shifts.

motion.name: duration-base

components.name: Button — Primary
components.description: Default filled button. Ink background, white text. For primary actions in documentation and utility contexts.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: oklch(0.145 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.205 0 0); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border: 1px solid oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Button — Ghost
components.description: Transparent button for navigation and utility actions. Fills with Surface Raised on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); }

components.name: RaisedButton — CTA
components.description: Signature tactile button for primary CTAs on marketing/landing surfaces. Shadow + top gradient overlay creates physical affordance.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-raised">Browse components <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-raised { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; background: #0080ff; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,128,255,0.5); box-shadow: 0 4px 5px 0 rgba(0,128,255,0.20); cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; transition: all 200ms ease-in-out; -webkit-font-smoothing: subpixel-antialiased; } .ds-btn-raised::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4); background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,0.2), transparent); border-radius: 14px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-raised:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-raised:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-raised:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,128,255,0.4); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input. Stroke-based, transparent background. Focus shifts border to ring color with soft glow.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.04); outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.description: Filled pill badge. Same authority as a filled button; use sparingly.

components.name: Badge — Outline
components.description: Border-only badge for metadata and secondary labels.

components.name: Message Bubble — Sent
components.description: iOS iMessage-style bubble for user-sent messages. The primary chromatic moment in the system.
components.html: Can you help me build a chatbot?
components.css: .ds-bubble { word-wrap: break-word; line-height: 24px; position: relative; padding: 8px 20px; max-width: 60%; border-radius: 20px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-bubble-sent { background: #00bbff; color: #000000; align-self: flex-end; } .ds-bubble-sent::before { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; right: -7px; width: 20px; height: 18px; background: #00bbff; border-bottom-left-radius: 16px 14px; } .ds-bubble-sent::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; right: -26px; width: 26px; height: 18px; background: oklch(1 0 0); border-bottom-left-radius: 10px; }

components.name: Message Bubble — Received
components.description: iOS iMessage-style bubble for AI/assistant received messages.
components.html: Sure, here are some components to get you started.
components.css: .ds-bubble-received { background: #d4d4d8; color: #000000; align-self: flex-start; } .ds-bubble-received::before { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: -7px; width: 20px; height: 18px; background: #d4d4d8; border-bottom-right-radius: 16px; } .ds-bubble-received::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: -26px; width: 26px; height: 18px; background: oklch(1 0 0); border-bottom-right-radius: 10px; }

narrative.overview:
GAIA UI is built-in-production and shared without ceremony. The design system proves quality by example: the precision of the components makes the argument; the site doesn't state it. Every surface follows the logic of the things it showcases.

The palette is achromatic by decision, not default. Neutrals carry the full weight of hierarchy; the single vivid color (electric blue, #00bbff) appears only in contexts where it earns its presence. The rarity of that blue is the point.

The typographic system uses Inter throughout: a single workhorse typeface managed through weight and scale contrast rather than family switching.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic neutral base with one exact chromatic accent (electric blue)
Flat surfaces at rest; tactile only where interaction demands it
Inter at scale — hierarchy through weight and size, not decoration
Generous but varied whitespace; spacing is the primary structural tool
Dual-theme: light and dark both first-class, neither an afterthought

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Electric blue (#00bbff) and CTA blue (#0080ff) are the only chromatic colors in the system. They appear on ≤5% of any given surface. Rarity is the signal.

rules.name: The Zero Chroma Base Rule
rules.body: All neutral tokens carry chroma = 0. No tinted grays, no warm whites in the neutral stack. The achromatic base is intentional.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Resist the impulse to add a second display typeface. Inter's weight range (400–700) provides the full expressive range needed.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If a surface doesn't need to communicate pressability or stacking, it has no shadow. Tonal differentiation handles layering for everything else.

dos: Do use oklch(0.145 0 0) (Ink) as the default foreground and button fill in light mode.
Do reserve electric blue (#00bbff) for user-sent message bubbles and hover accents.
Do reserve CTA blue (#0080ff) for primary RaisedButton CTAs.
Do vary spacing to create rhythm — identical padding on every section is visual monotony.
Do use active:scale-95 on all interactive elements that benefit from tactile feedback.
Do support both light and dark themes for every new component.
Do cap prose line length at 70ch.
Do use weight contrast (400 vs 600) within Inter before resorting to size changes.
donts: Don't use MUI or Chakra UI's visual language: heavy borders, municipal color palettes, utility-first aesthetics.
Don't use SaaS template patterns: gradient hero blobs, gradient-clipped text, hero-metric blocks, identical feature card grids.
Don't add chromatic colors beyond electric blue and CTA blue.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, padding, margin).
Don't use bounce or elastic easing.
Don't add shadows to components that don't communicate pressability or stacking.
